title: FIPS gate missing in wolfssl_ec_key_export_public/private helpers
description: wolfssl_ec_key.c:274 (wolfssl_ec_key_export_public) and wolfssl_ec_key.c:303 (wolfssl_ec_key_export_private) are ungated helper functions. The gate contract is enforced only by per-algo wrappers in wolfssl_ecdsa.c and wolfssl_ecdh.c. Today the ops tables never expose these helpers directly, so the live code is safe. But a future caller that bypasses the wrapper would silently execute key export without a FIPS gate. The fix is to add wolfssl_fips_gate() as the first executable statement in both helpers, removing the reliance on caller discipline for a FIPS 140-3 requirement.
close_reason: Added wolfssl_fips_gate() as first executable statement in wolfssl_ec_key_export_public and wolfssl_ec_key_export_private; moved int ret to top scope, removed inner declarations from #ifdef blocks
